title: Claude Fable 5: mid-tier results on coding tasks
summary: Endor Labs conducted benchmark testing on Claude Fable 5's coding capabilities and found it performs at a mid-tier level, contradicting some of the hype surrounding its release. The article provides empirical data to help developers make informed decisions about which AI coding assistants to use.
problem_solved: Cut through marketing hype by providing objective performance data on AI coding assistants
why_valuable: Helps developers and teams make evidence-based decisions about AI tooling rather than relying on vendor claims
